## LoggerNumericLevels interface

The numeric levels of the log level names.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface LoggerNumericLevels extends Readonly<Record<LogLevel, number>> 
```
**Extends:** Readonly&lt;Record&lt;[LogLevel](./logger.loglevel.md)<!-- -->, number&gt;&gt;

## Remarks

It is the type of `Logger.numericLevels`<!-- -->. The properties are the level names of `LogLevel`<!-- -->, and their values are the numeric levels, which are kept as literal types, so that the compiler knows the exact values. Higher values mean more verbosity.
